role: independent adversarial verifier (did not modify implementation code)

defects.fix: two new conditions: real_improvement_over_run (first - best > delta_val) and tail_within_delta_val_of_best (|final - best| <= delta_val)
one marginal rule for every branch: audited block variance (or the declared upper bound while unaudited) is added to each sample's own variance

mutation_experiments.method: pristine src copied to /tmp/mutant/src, one mutation applied there, tests run with PYTHONPATH=/tmp/mutant/src from the worktree (no mutation entered the worktree)
results: M1 variance-map interpolation replaces a.T Sigma a
M2 pull sign flipped in source_xy
M3 author-loss legal mask loosened
M4 plateau additionally requires best_index > 0 (D1 fix)
M5 resume drops numpy/torch RNG restore
M6 diagonal branch adds block variance (D2 fix)
M7 ledger.without skips physical redaction
M8 pooled mask loosened to always-true
M9 proxy ignores the declared var_min clamp
M10 builder columns unfiltered
M11 readout in_dim defaults to readout_width
M12 step counts two arrivals per event
M13 supervision leaked into visible metadata
M14 selection split check dropped
M15 calibrated flag ignored for a supplied table
M16 exposure gain applied once to the variance
mutation_experiments.tripwire_note: M4 and M6 make the D1/D2 xfail tests fail as strict XPASS, so fixing either defect forces the marker to be removed

revert_checks_after_fix.method: the fixed src was copied to /tmp/mutant/src and the fix locally reverted; the converted assertions must fail (no mutation entered the worktree)
results: R1 revert both D1 conditions
3 failed: degrading, constant, drift
R2 revert only the D1 drift condition (partial fix)
2 failed: degrading (wrong condition value) and the new drift test; the constant test still passes, showing the drift test's added value
R3 revert the D2 diagonal block term
1 failed: single-sample-block marginal

not_covered: real SEA-RAFT weights / any GPU or server run (CPU-only local verification)
the raw_adapter real (non-smoke) preflight on both platforms; only its missing-asset hard-failure and the local smoke receipt are checked
motion evaluation four-arm metrics (EPE quantiles, AUC, p50/p95 latency, memory) beyond the calibration-only fit refusal and the static/o rbit labels
the checkpoint selection winner identity across real training runs (only the guard paths)
32-frame window behaviour under multiple cameras/episodes in one stream
